summary: The exact DESIGN_READY handoff is compatible with UI-001 requirements, frontend-only architecture, low-risk trust boundaries, accessibility and reduced-motion obligations, scroll-performance constraints, task scope, and the established Clinical Glass / Continuity Aurora brand system.
review_scope: Compatibility only. Do not substitute orchestrator aesthetic preferences for frontend specialist design authority.

checks.requirements: PASS — preserves LAND-001, specifies distinct one-time role-card arrivals, extends the theme to every named workspace, reframes Deployment paths as a finished-product SaaS operating model, and removes demo/prototype positioning.
checks.architecture_and_contracts: PASS — remains presentation-only inside the existing React frontend, changes no reducer, persistence, route, API, backend, database, infrastructure, contract, or caregiver-projection boundary.
checks.security_and_authorization: PASS — introduces no trust-boundary change and explicitly preserves the caregiver allowlist and truthful local role-selection behavior.
checks.accessibility: PASS — preserves semantic controls, focus visibility, non-color state cues, target sizes, modal focus behavior, content-visible fallback, and complete system/user reduced-motion equivalence.
checks.performance: PASS — replaces fixed/broad blur and nested-scroll costs, uses one-time observer-driven compositor-safe reveals with cleanup, retains canvas safeguards, and defers live map work near the viewport.
checks.scope: PASS — uses existing frontend dependencies and assets, avoids pricing/checkout/fake sales behavior, and stays within frontend/design/report paths.
checks.human_brand_design_system_constraints: PASS — extends the approved Clinical Glass / Continuity Aurora system without replacing the landing direction, official identity, palette, typography, or operational density rules.

notes_for_frontend: Implement this exact approved handoff after syncing the frontend worktree and passing the design gate; changing frontend-design-report.json requires a fresh digest review.
Keep user-facing product copy confident and final-product oriented; internal claim constraints must not appear as disclaimer panels or prototype language.
Preserve any unrelated user-owned changes outside the frontend worktree and do not modify backend, database, contracts, task.json, or workflow semantics.
